sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase: a new warning from the Brucebase feed (BruceParser 0.24.0): ⚠️ ⇋ a show's Notes, Gallery, Eyewitness, Media or Recording notes page whose name is not the show's, as its breadcrumb names the show. For example gallery:1967-11-00-… under gig:1967-11-00a-… (a missing day letter), "palais-omnisport" under "palais-omnisports" (a typo), or a page under a show of another date or place. A name Wikidot cut at its 60 characters, a "-1"/"-2" of two pages of one date and the "dl-" of a download's note count as fine. The show is marked on its rows, its page and its window, the page itself on its rows (Recent changes, the tag lists); the hover text names the page and the name it would have. 36 pages in the run of 2026-11-19. Its own switch in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ Findings, on by default.
